profile.input_contract: JSON thermal diffusivity, mesh/time step, and initial temperature profile.
profile.output_contract: JSON temperature metrics including max_temperature and convergence proxies.
profile.adapter: Python heat-equation runner with input/output adapters under SUT/heat_equation/.

mrs.description: 1D heat equation with homogeneous Dirichlet BCs is linear in the initial profile. Scaling the initial amplitude by factor > 1 must scale max_u at t_final by the same factor.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: 1D heat equation with homogeneous Dirichlet BCs is linear in the initial profile.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleAmplitude via transform steps [ScaleField@/initial/amplitude] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `max_u` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `heat-equation-amplitude`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `greater` / `GreaterThan` checks the expected relation on `max_u`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `heat-equation` exposes sample `sample/gaussian.json`, the transform target fields, and output `max_u`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.

mrs.description: Time-step convergence MP_conv: doubling num_steps (halving the forward-Euler time-step dt) must leave max_u(t_final) within Euler truncation tolerance — the integrator is already at the fine-grid plateau given the chosen alpha.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Conv MR: Time-step convergence MP_conv: doubling num_steps (halving the forward-Euler time-step dt) must leave max_u(t_final) within Euler truncation tolerance — the integrator is already at the fine-grid plateau given the chosen alpha.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField via transform steps [ScaleField@/params/num_steps] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `max_u` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `fourier-timestep-convergence`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `approx` / `ApproxEqual` checks the expected relation on `max_u`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Deterministic tolerance rel=0.01, abs=1e-06 bounds acceptable numeric deviation.

mrs.description: Diffusion coefficient monotonicity MP_mono: at fixed t_final, larger alpha causes faster diffusive smoothing of the initial profile, so scaling alpha by factor > 1 must strictly decrease max_u(t_final).
